itens.titulo: Citi hikes Bitcoin, Ethereum price targets by over 35%
itens.descricao: Citi hikes Bitcoin, Ethereum price targets by over 35% Yahoo Finance
trechos: Citigroup raised its 12-month price targets for Bitcoin and Ethereum, which is the world's second-largest cryptocurrency by more than 35%, Reuters reported on Oct.
The bank now sees Bitcoin at $113,000 and Ether at $3,028 within a year, up from the $82,000 and $2,240 it forecast when it slashed both targets three months ago.
For context, Citi traces its lineage to the City Bank of New York, chartered in 1812, the year the United States went to war with Britain.
The institution has outlasted the Civil War, the Great Depression and the 2008 crisis it barely survived.
When Citi slashed Bitcoin, Ether targets in July Citi cut its targets on July 1, citing weak investor appetite, outflows from crypto exchange-traded funds and stalled legislation in Washington.
Its bear case saw Bitcoin as low as $53,000 and Ether at $1,094.
July 1 also happened to be the first day of what became Bitcoin's best third quarter on record, a 42.7% return against a historical Q3 average of 8.7%, according to CoinGlass.
Ether did better still, returning roughly 54% over the three months.

itens.titulo: Amazon Inks $1B SNPS Deal to Power AWS Custom Chips: Should You Hold?
itens.descricao: Amazon Inks $1B SNPS Deal to Power AWS Custom Chips: Should You Hold? Yahoo Finance Australia
trechos: Amazon AMZN has deepened its custom silicon push by signing a strategic, multi-year intellectual property agreement with Synopsys SNPS, valued at more than $1 billion, to accelerate chip design for Amazon Web Services (AWS).

The deal builds on a collaboration spanning more than 15 years and supports Amazon's purpose-built chips, including Nitro for cloud security and networking, Graviton for general-purpose computing and Trainium for AI training and inference.
Synopsys will adopt Amazon EC2 and Amazon Bedrock for its own product development, creating a two-way commercial relationship.
Amazon's chips business has already surpassed a $25 billion annual revenue run rate, growing at triple-digit percentages year over year.
Graviton is used by 98% of the top 1,000 EC2 customers, while Trainium has secured multi-year, multi-gigawatt commitments from Anthropic and OpenAI.
In August, AWS and NVIDIA unveiled plans to deploy an additional 2 million Blackwell Ultra, Rubin and Rubin Ultra GPUs across AWS infrastructure in 2027-2028, along with Vera CPU support.
AWS revenues grew 37% year over year to $42.2 billion in the second quarter of 2026, its fastest growth in 18 quarters, taking the annualized revenue run rate to $169 billion.
Segment operating margin expanded to 39.4% from 32.9% a year ago.

itens.titulo: Petrobras (PETR4) eleva preço do querosene de aviação em 11% em em outubro
itens.descricao: Petrobras (PETR4) eleva preço do querosene de aviação em 11% em em outubro Money Times
itens.texto:
Petrobras (PETR4) eleva preço do querosene de aviação em 11% em em outubro
A Petrobras (PETR4) aumentou em 11,8% o preço médio de venda de querosene de aviação (QAV) para as distribuidoras a partir desta quinta-feira (1), diante da disparada de preços do petróleo e de seus derivados no mercado internacional em setembro.
“ O reajuste anunciado reflete a elevação das cotações internacionais do Querosene de Aviação, ocasionado pelo recrudescimento das tensões geopolíticas no Oriente Médio”, disse a Petrobras, em comunicado.
O ajuste, que terá vigência em outubro, corresponde a uma alta de R$ 0,66 por litro em relação ao preço da estatal de setembro.
O aumento mensal ocorre após uma elevação média de cerca de 13,9% em setembro em relação ao mês anterior.
A Petrobras disse que a precificação do QAV no mercado brasileiro segue uma fórmula paramétrica contratual que funciona como amortecedor de curto prazo, resultando em reajustes mais moderados que os praticados internacionalmente.
“Diante disso, os reajustes acumulados desde o início do conflito foram superiores nos mercados internacionais em relação aos observados no Brasil, indicando que o preço do QAV da Petrobras permanece competitivo”, afirmou a companhia.
Dentre os principais pontos de venda, a alta do combustível em Guarulhos (SP) foi de 11,6%, conforme cálculo realizado com base na tabela de preços divulgada pela companhia, enquanto em Duque de Caxias (RJ) foi de 12% e em Betim (MG), 11,6%.
Adicionalmente, a Petrobras destacou que os volumes de QAV solicitados pelas distribuidoras para outubro estão confirmados, “mantendo assim a garantia de abastecimento nos polos de atendimento”.

itens.titulo: Will Chevron (CVX) Beat Estimates Again in Its Next Earnings Report?
itens.descricao: Will Chevron (CVX) Beat Estimates Again in Its Next Earnings Report? Yahoo! Finance Canada
trechos: The average surprise for the last two quarters was 28.87%.
For the last reported quarter, Chevron came out with earnings of $6.06 per share versus the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $5.8 per share, representing a surprise of 4.48%.
For the previous quarter, the company was expected to post earnings of $0.92 per share and it actually produced earnings of $1.41 per share, delivering a surprise of 53.26%.
Our research shows that stocks with the combination of a positive Earnings ESP and a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) or better produce a positive surprise nearly 70% of the time.
In other words, if you have 10 stocks with this combination, the number of stocks that beat the consensus estimate could be as high as seven.
Chevron currently has an Earnings ESP of +4.60%, which suggests that analysts have recently become bullish on the company's earnings prospects.
This positive Earnings ESP when combined with the stock's Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) indicates that another beat is possibly around the corner.
